# Cash Out

![Cash Out](https://scholzdev.github.io/tossup/img/coins/cash_out.png)

Heads: 3 points, squares the combo multiplier, banks its pot, then resets the combo.

- **Rarity:** Rare
- **Heads chance:** 30%
- **Shop price:** 15 gold
- **Energy to flip:** 0

## Heads
Score 3 points

## Tails
Nothing

## Who can use it
- **Starts in the deck of:** none
- **Usable in coin sets from the start:** none
- **Found in the shop and unlocked by buying it once:** [The Blade](characters-blade)
